name: 24008-longprefill-opt125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. TP=1 is declared, not a convenience.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 10000 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets; prompts exactly 1500 tokens and outputs exactly 150, every prompt distinct, ignore_eos forced whenever max_tokens is set.
purpose: A compact text summarizer handling 1500-token documents with short summaries for 1024 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 37241077d563d5808ce8f36ebce4eec25e1c1f88 (git describe = v0.10.1rc1-500-g37241077d5).

model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# DO NOT DELETE THESE TWO AS "the defaults": the async engine path's usage context is in neither
# per-usage-context default table at this commit, so leaving them unpinned silently falls through
# to much smaller values and the declared 1024-stream operating point is clamped by the engine.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

disable-log-stats: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
